execution_rules.atomic_staging_mechanism: Write to .part staging directory, verify checksums and integrity, then atomically rename to canonical run directory.
execution_rules.receipt_recording: Written synchronously after each checkpoint evaluation with exact hashes, byte counts, and timestamps.

crash_before_inference.protocol: Clean up uncommitted temporary files, log root cause to incident log, and restart preflight under verified conditions.

crash_after_predictions_exist.protocol: FAIL-CLOSED. No silent retry or automated re-execution. Quarantine artifacts and halt pipeline for formal human investigation.

post_evaluation_lock: Following completion of the 5 model evaluations, outputs are cryptographically sealed. Only the preregistered confirmatory and descriptive analyses may be executed on the generated prediction vectors.
